host_binding.minimum_policy: astra plus at least one of brat or sedzia-ci

required_behavior: the new CI key never occupies or aliases the brat slot
all present keys are normalized, validated and pairwise distinct
two distinct EFFECT statements remain required
a sedzia-ci statement must bind to a sedzia-ci-run- lineage
the existing Astra plus Brat path remains valid
PREPARE_ONLY, STOP, grants, transaction safety and protected evidence remain unchanged
residuals: the judge workflow and replay code were authored by Braun and remain reviewable rather than independently authored
GitHub repository administrators can change workflow code, refs, secrets and environment admission; this is an administrative trust anchor, not hardware-backed custody
encrypted private-key material committed by a workflow is only as independent as repository secret custody, branch controls and workflow immutability
reported R0 and R1 measurements are not accepted as operational attestations until exact signed artifacts and run provenance are verified
fresh hidden holdout, natural host restart, real cycle, EFFECT statements and owner grant remain required
